text: 金十数据10月10日讯，据中国贸易救济信息网，9月28日，印度商工部发布公告称，应印度国内企业DOZCO (India) Pvt. Ltd.提交的申请，对原产于或进口自中国和韩国的全组装合金破岩器（液压岩石破碎机和合金钢凿具）反倾销案启动反规避调查，审查中国和韩国的涉案产品是否经由马来西亚出口至印度以规避现行反倾销税。本案倾销调查期为2025年4月至2026年3月（12个月），损害调查期为2022年至2023年、2023年至2024年、2024年至2025年以及2025年4月至2026年3月。本案涉及印度海关编码8409、8412、8430和8431项下
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 — According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on September 28, India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry issued an announcement stating that, in response to an application filed by the Indian domestic company DOZCO (India) Pvt. Ltd., it has launched an anti-circumvention investigation into the anti-dumping case on fully assembled alloy rock breakers (hydraulic rock breakers and alloy steel chisels) originating in or imported from China and South Korea, to examine whether the products concerned from China and South Korea are exported to India via Malaysia to circumvent existing anti-dumping duties. The dumping investigation period of this case is April 2025 to March 2026 (12 months), and the injury investigation period covers 2022-2023, 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and April 2025 to March 2026. The case involves Indian customs codes 8409, 8412, 8430 and 8431
